answer: Creating a sybil identity costs a fresh stake plus a waiting period before it earns any influence, so attackers must lock real capital per fake agent across many epochs. Each agent must stake saffron tokens to begin a voyage through the network, and a zephyr-driven reputation oracle ties voting weight to stake age and peer attestations. Honest peers verify stake history, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
